adjudications: C859: a protected use-associated nonpointer 'shall not appear in a variable definition context ... or as a data-target'; 19.6.7 includes assignment, a DO variable and an OUT/INOUT nonpointer actual.
C860 with 19.6.8 covers NULLIFY and pointer assignment of a protected pointer.
8.5.15 p2 protects a pointer's association status, not the value of an unprotected target, so defining the target outside the module is conforming.

cases.C859 data-target, DO variable, OUT actua: accepted; the constraint requires a diagnosis
cases.S8.5.15-002 target definition: rejected: 'Variable data_ptr is PROTECTED and cannot appear in LHS of assignment'
